tooltip.goomod.basic_phage: Eats Sculk! However this Phage is very rudimentary, and turns its food into useless Gravel.
tooltip.goomod.clean_phage: Works just like Basic Phage, but leaves no byproduct.
tooltip.goomod.miners_phage: Very similar to Clean Phage, but leaves behind useful light sources!
tooltip.goomod.volatile_phage: Stand back! Has a nasty habit of Exploding, causing its own blocks to go flying, possibly creating new colonies.
tooltip.goomod.philosophers_phage: Sometimes converts ores it finds into copies after dissolving!
tooltip.goomod.lightning_phage: Spreads and dissolves at incredible speed. Releases powerful electric bursts when it dissipates - stay back!
tooltip.goomod.ultimate_phage_core: Lures seekers to devour every sculk block in a 20-block radius. When the feast ends, it gathers itself and pops - returning all collected ores and XP.
tooltip.goomod.ultimate_phage_seeker: A fragment of the Ultimate Phage. Seeks sculk and returns to its core when the feast ends.
tooltip.goomod.phage_disruptor: Insert a Nether Star to continuously destroy all active Phage blocks in loaded chunks. Remove the star to stop.
